Located within the section analyzing pairs or dyads (Dukapaṭṭhāna), the text evaluates mental and material phenomena categorized under the clinging or grasping cluster (*upādāna-gocchaka*) through the Abhidhamma system of twenty-four conditional relations (*paccaya*) [SuttaCentral].
